GitDiff.description: staged=false: index → working tree (fingerprint is the working file); staged=true: HEAD → index. indexFingerprint is null when the path has no stage-0 index entry.

GitLog.description: Commits in date order (children before parents). all=true lists every local/remote branch and tag (ignored for file history); scope echoes it and is missing from runtimes older than the commit graph.

GitBlame.description: Uncommitted lines use commit ''. Ranges are 1-based and cover the working file.

SearchMatch.description: line is 1-based; column/length/previewColumn are UTF-16 code units (column 1-based).

ReviewDiff.description: exists/fingerprint describe the current working file when `to` is omitted.
